Sanjay Leela Bhansali's film 'Love & War' reportedly wraps shooting

Filmmaker Sanjay Leela Bhansali's upcoming movie, 'Love & War', has reportedly completed its principal photography. The film stars actors Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, and Vicky Kaushal. Details about the plot or release date have not been disclosed.
